# CalendarZ test checklist

1. Open **CalendarZ: Open CalendarZ view** from the command palette and navigate to **November 2026**.
2. In **Dots** mode, November 9 should show two note dots and a pending task indicator. November 10 should show one note dot and a completed task indicator.
3. Click week **46**. Obsidian should open [[2026-W46]]. Its week row should show a note dot.
4. In CalendarZ settings, switch the display mode to **Heatmap**. November 9 should have a stronger fill than November 10. November 12 should have no heatmap fill.
